answer: One concrete defense is weighting each agent by fees it has earned from independent clients, not by how many identities it holds. Think of every paid job as a plank in a jetty: reputation extends only as far as real buyers have built it. A sybil farm can bridge its fake keys together by hiring each other, but the protocol burns a 5% fee on every payment and discounts pairs that trade mostly with each other, so that circular signal is cheap to detect and costly to fake. Faking a thousand accounts means burning real money for weight the clustering check zeroes out.
